note: Shared variant catalog — every entry is written to be archetype-agnostic so it applies to ANY character in the cast. 'starter_pack' flags the small set generated first per character for cost control; the rest expand later based on which characters/variants actually get used.

canon.label: Default
canon.prompt: neutral confident standing pose, friendly default expression, wearing their signature default outfit

expressions.label: Furious
expressions.prompt: FURIOUS rage expression, steam-red face, gritted bared teeth, veins popping on forehead, fists clenched tight, aggressive lunging pose, same default outfit

expressions.label: Overjoyed
expressions.prompt: massive over-the-top joyful grin, eyes squeezed shut with joy, cheeks puffed up, both arms thrown up in celebration, same default outfit

expressions.label: Cackling
expressions.prompt: uncontrollable laughing fit, head thrown back, mouth wide open cackling, doubled over holding stomach with one hand, same default outfit

expressions.label: Bawling
expressions.prompt: exaggerated bawling cry, waterfall tears streaming down, scrunched wet face, trembling lip, hunched sobbing pose, same default outfit

expressions.label: Shocked
expressions.prompt: eyes bulging wide in shock, jaw dropped to the floor, both hands slapped on cheeks, frozen stiff pose, same default outfit

expressions.label: Calm
expressions.prompt: calm friendly neutral smile, relaxed casual stance, same default outfit

gestures.label: Pointing
gestures.prompt: pointing aggressively straight at the camera with one hand, confident smirk, same default outfit

gestures.label: Facepalm
gestures.prompt: one hand covering face in an exasperated facepalm, slouched defeated posture, same default outfit

gestures.label: Shrug
gestures.prompt: big exaggerated shrug, both palms up at shoulder height, confused open-mouth expression, same default outfit

gestures.label: Crossed Arms
gestures.prompt: arms crossed tightly over chest, smug superior expression, same default outfit

gestures.label: Jumping
gestures.prompt: captured mid-air jump, arms and legs spread wide, excited open-mouth yell, same default outfit

gestures.label: Dancing
gestures.prompt: goofy dance pose, one leg kicked up high, arms flailing sideways, same default outfit

gestures.label: On Phone
gestures.prompt: looking down at a phone held in both hands, glowing screen light on face, same default outfit

gestures.label: Thinking
gestures.prompt: hand on chin in an exaggerated thinking pose, eyes looking up and to the side, one eyebrow raised, same default outfit

gestures.label: Thumbs Up
gestures.prompt: big thumbs up gesture with both hands, wide cheesy grin, winking one eye, same default outfit

costumes.label: Zombie
costumes.prompt: reanimated zombie version of the character, pale sickly green-grey skin, torn shredded default outfit, visible stitches, hollow undead eyes, still clearly recognizable as the same character

costumes.label: Pirate
costumes.prompt: wearing a pirate captain outfit with tricorn hat, eyepatch, and a hook hand, neutral confident expression

costumes.label: Astronaut
costumes.prompt: wearing a bulky white astronaut spacesuit with the helmet tucked under one arm, neutral confident expression

costumes.label: Business Suit
costumes.prompt: wearing a sharp formal business suit and tie, neutral confident expression

costumes.label: Streetwear
costumes.prompt: wearing a baggy streetwear hoodie and sneakers, relaxed casual expression

costumes.label: Sportswear
costumes.prompt: wearing an athletic tracksuit and a headband, energetic expression

costumes.label: Christmas
costumes.prompt: wearing a Santa hat and an ugly Christmas sweater, cheerful expression

costumes.label: Halloween
costumes.prompt: wearing a cheap homemade monster Halloween costume over their default outfit, mischievous expression

costumes.label: Construction
costumes.prompt: wearing a hi-vis safety vest and a hard hat, holding a small wrench, neutral confident expression

costumes.label: Chef
costumes.prompt: wearing a chef's white coat and a tall chef hat, proud expression

costumes.label: Police
costumes.prompt: wearing a police uniform and cap, stern authoritative expression

costumes.label: Ninja
costumes.prompt: wearing a black ninja outfit with a face mask covering everything but the eyes, focused expression

costumes.label: Rich
costumes.prompt: wearing an over-the-top flashy rich outfit dripping with gold chains and jewelry, smug expression

costumes.label: Homeless
costumes.prompt: wearing a tattered ragged version of their default outfit with dirt smudges, weary expression

costumes.label: Baby Version
costumes.prompt: shrunk into a chibi baby version of themselves, even more oversized head, wearing a diaper or onesie, tiny stubby body proportions, innocent expression
